input.summary: Vembanad Botanicals (V03) replied with a proposal and a rosemary COA (batch VB-RM-2411-03). Open issue: RM-008 COA retest date 2026-11-30 falls before our 20 Dec 2026 need-by; asking for a COA with a later retest date (0/3 tries used). Knockout questionnaire gaps Q5 (COA per line), Q9 (SDS and leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020) are outstanding; Q8 (manufacturer or trader, second source, delivery/rejection records) is non-knockout. Requested vendor reply by 14 Nov 2026. No refusals or promises so far.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: rosemary COA and outstanding questionnaire items
input.body:
Dear Meera,

Thank you for your proposal and the rosemary COA.

1. Rosemary leaf extract (RM-008): The COA for batch VB-RM-2411-03 shows a retest date of 30 November 2026. This is before our first need-by date of 20 December 2026, so we cannot use this batch as shown. Please provide a COA from a current batch with a retest date after 20 December 2026, covering the full 6-month supply window.

2. Certificates of Analysis (knockout): Please provide a recent COA for each of the 10 lines, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.

3. Safety Data Sheets and suitability (knockout): Please provide the SDS for each material and confirm that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

4. Manufacturer and supply chain: Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Please reply by 14 November 2026. Items 2 and 3 are required before we can progress your quote.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
